## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /api/v1/users/publicagents/{publicagentToken}` — Get public agent details by token.
- `GET /api/v1/users/subscriptions/public-account-quota/{public-account-quotaToken}` — Get public account quota details by token.

### Data Read (6)
- `GET /api/activities` — Get a list of activities.
- `GET /api/letter/webBanner` — Get the web banner for letters.
- `GET /api/pay/package/v2` — Get available payment packages.
- `GET /api/product/list` — Get a list of available products.
- `GET /api/reward/activity/list` — Get a list of reward activities.
- `GET /api/user/profile_and_features` — Get the user's profile and features.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /p/conversions/c/v` — Record a conversion event.

### Search (1)
- `GET /api/experiment/query` — Query for experiments.

### Config (1)
- `GET /api/config/{configId}` — Get a specific configuration by ID.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to App Klingai's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access App Klingai data without official API access
- Automate actions on app.klingai.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the App Klingai frontend uses
